## Developer PR Checklist

Before submitting the PR, please ensure you've completed the following:

### 1. Research & Development
- [ ] Ensure comprehensive testing of all possible options and settings.
- [ ] Validate that design variations work as intended.

### 2. CSS & HTML
- [ ] Inspect CSS thoroughly for any layout or styling issues.
- [ ] Ensure responsive behavior is functioning correctly across different devices.
- [ ] Optimize HTML markup for clean, semantic structure.
- [ ] Verify that CSS selectors are efficient and well-optimized.
- [ ] Ensure CSS class names follow the **BEM (Block Element Modifier)** naming convention (all lowercase letters).
- [ ] Resolve any CSS conflicts, especially within testing blocks.

### 3. Block Functionality & Compatibility
- [ ] Check that blocks are functioning properly when added to the page.
- [ ] Test **Inner Container Blocks** for correct rendering and layout.
- [ ] Validate that block duplication works without errors.
- [ ] Ensure block styles can be copied and pasted without issues.
- [ ] Verify that block patterns are compatible across different contexts.
- [ ] Test for any **Block Validation Errors** during page load and save.

### 4. Theme & Plugin Compatibility
- [ ] Perform thorough **Theme Compatibility** testing with various themes.
- [ ] Check for any page or block conflicts with other plugins.
- [ ] Ensure enabling/disabling settings has no unintended side effects.

### 5. Asset & Performance Optimization
- [ ] Ensure proper generation of assets (CSS, JS) and test their functionality.
- [ ] Inspect and resolve any performance-related issues, such as slow page load times.

### 6. Advanced Settings
- [ ] Confirm that all advanced panel settings are working as expected.
  
### 7. Visual Checks
- [ ] Ensure that all icons in default controls are consistent (check that all icons appear the same; any discrepancies are a problem).
